title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.value: Clearly nonuniform spacing in this short sample, with two longer intervals and several shorter intervals. No whole-record rhythm classification is inferred.
fields.basis: Provisional positive peak-to-peak spacing in original PDF 585
fields.reason: Selected pixel gaps: 46.5 px, 45.5 px, 57 px, 83.5 px, 53.5 px, 49.5 px, 71 px, 52 px, 49 px, 41.5 px, 41.5 px, 52.5 px, 48 px. These describe a short sample, not a validated rhythm classification.

fields.basis: Assumed course speed 25 mm/s; 149 detected lines enclose 148 minor horizontal intervals across 726 pixels in the observed calibration segment.
fields.reason: 13 retained positive peak-to-peak intervals have mean spacing 53.15 px, giving 138.4 bpm. Individual-interval estimates span approximately 88.1–177.3 bpm under the same assumption; this is observed interval variation, not a confidence interval. No numerical speed label or labeled timing duration is verified on this strip. This is interval-derived, not a six-second beat count or a claim of a stable rate.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Broad, predominantly downward intercomplex excursions rise into shoulders before the next tall stroke. Those shoulders are visible but lack separately resolved P onset and offset. Some longer intervals contain extra shallow undulations. There is no distinct isolated P candidate with a defensible onset. Shoulder apex windows are recorded only as possible competing features, not as atrial events.
fields.basis: Original PDF page 585; independently reconciled selected-complex observation
fields.reason: Provisional deflection description, not validated atrial identity or a diagnosis. Descriptive visible morphology only. No validated atrial identity, sinus origin, electrical conduction, absent-P claim or forced one-to-one correspondence. Where is the true ventricular offset on the steep-to-shallow descending contour? Are the intercomplex shoulders atrial activity, repolarization or overlapping components? Can a consistent terminal boundary be located on both the rounded and flatter-bottom examples? This describes only the selected complexes or restricted subset. It does not establish a whole-strip event census, ventricular sequence completeness, atrial identity, or conduction relationship. Qualified ECG educator review is outstanding.

fields.value: Fourteen repeated sharp upward excursions, followed by lower, broader downward contours. Peak height and spacing vary. Small shoulders and intervening curves are visible but are not assigned P/T identity.
fields.basis: New descriptive observation of the original raster, not a source-authored rhythm diagnosis
fields.reason: No diagnostic rhythm label, validated P-wave identity, conduction interval or clinical conclusion is assigned. Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.
pr unresolved: No separable P onset/offset or unique P-to-QRS association is resolved.
qrs unresolved: A repeatable QRS-to-post-complex junction is unresolved. Early-knee arithmetic is retained only as a rejected-for-field scenario.
No validated atrial identity or atrioventricular relationship; visible bumps/oscillations are described without asserting P-wave presence or absence.
No secure P onset and conduction relationship, and no verified individual-strip speed.
Onset/offset boundaries in this resampled raster are not validated; sharpness does not establish a numerical QRS duration.
Ventricular onset and terminal repolarization boundary are not validated; no correction formula is applied.
Per-strip gain/calibration is not verified; no quantitative amplitude is assigned.
Not derived from morphology or rate alone; qualified educator review required.
The reported rate is conditional on course timing and provisional landmark identity, not a verified per-strip answer.
All derived fields remain provisional and excluded from validated scoring.
Only the directly observed horizontal calibration segment is used. Its line count may exclude strip borders; no full-strip duration is inferred from unlabeled marks or a prior page.

Pixel-picking and grid-sensitivity allowances are illustrative, not confidence intervals. Unknown paper speed, missed events, waveform identity and phase comparability are not bounded by those allowances.
A mean can conceal changing spacing. No sustained rate or diagnostic rhythm is inferred.

Both independently measured clear bands contain contiguous 4–6 px gaps and corresponding line centers agree within one pixel. find_peaks excludes the x-range endpoints. The line arrays are interior measured calibration spans, not a full-width duration count; page 587 has a different grid phase and a different detected count.

No complete sharp interior complex is intentionally omitted. Rounded between-complex contours are not extra ventricular events. The first peak has only a short preceding segment; no interval before it is measured.
